# kion_aws_resource_tag (Resource)

Manages a Kion AWS Resource Tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_aws_resource_tag" "example" {
  # Optional
  # resource_key   = "example"
  # resource_value = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `resource_key` (String) ResourceKey is the resource tag's key.
- `resource_value` (String) ResourceValue is the resource tag's value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the AWS Resource Tag.
